SABIS® is a global education network that has an active presence in 21 countries on five continents and educates students in both the private and public sectors. SABIS® schools implement the proven, proprietary SABIS® Educational System, which has been developed and refined for over 140 years.

All students in the SABIS® Network benefit from a long tradition of excellence in education, a reputation that is rooted in a well-developed philosophy that seeks to provide students with a top-quality education that prepares them to meet the challenges of a changing world.
For more information about the SABIS® Network, visit: www.sabis.net.

r: Completing all lesson plans and maintaining daily reflection of the lessons. The plans and evaluations will be reviewed by the HOD.
Teaching lessons according to the SABIS® Physical Education Curriculum. Developing and implementing drills and activities as per the points set out by the SABIS Point System®.
Training students for competitions. This includes, but may not be limited to, the development of written practice plans, performance tracking and associated departmental reports.

q: What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member.
Specific Job Knowledge, Skills And Ability

The individual must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to explain and demonstrate that he or she can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of skills and abilities.
Proven experience and expertise in polishing, with a thorough understanding of techniques and methods for different surfaces.
Proficient in using hand tools and power tools relevant to polishing work.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to achieve high-quality finishes.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.
CPR Certification and/or First Aid Training is an advantageous
r: Apply polishing paints and coatings to various surfaces throughout the hotel, including floors, walls, and furniture.
Prepare surfaces for polishing by cleaning, sanding, or buffing as needed to ensure optimal adhesion and finish.
Select appropriate polishing paints and coatings based on surface type, usage, and desired appearance.
Use painting and polishing equipment such as brushes, rollers, sprayers, and polishing machines safely and effectively.
Apply polishing paints and coatings evenly and accurately to achieve a smooth and consistent finish.
Follow manufacturer instructions and safety guidelines when handling and applying polishing paints and coatings.
Inspect finished surfaces for quality and touch up any imperfections or inconsistencies as necessary.
Coordinate with other members of the engineering team to schedule and prioritize polishing projects.
Maintain a clean and organized work environment, including proper storage and disposal of painting and polishing materials.
Adhere to health and safety regulations while working with painting and polishing chemicals and equipment.
Communicate effectively with engineering supervisors and colleagues regarding project progress and any issues encountered.
Stay updated on new polishing techniques, materials, and equipment to enhance skills and efficiency.

In addition to performance of the essential functions, this position may be required to perform a combination of the following supportive functions, with the percentage of time performing each function to be solely determined by the supervisor based upon the particular requirements of the company
Providing input on material selection for optimal results.
Collaborating with other departments for scheduling projects.
Keeping records of materials used and project progress.
Collaborate with carpenters and other maintenance staff to assist in the repair or refurbishment of items before polishing, when necessary.
Supporting colleagues with tasks as needed.

q: •B.E / B.Tech / B.Sc in Civil Engineering or a related field.
•15 – 20 years of experience, including 7+ years in a senior management role, in civil works mainly for Substation, Tower Line and Underground Cable projects.
•Valid Kuwait Society of Engineers (KSE) membership and PMP certification are a must.
•Strong project leadership and execution, budgeting and cost control, planning and scheduling, QA/QC, reporting and presentation skills.
•Sound knowledge of industry safety aspects and local regulations; able to lead, coach and communicate with stakeholders at all levels.
r: •Lead and oversee the execution of civil works for substations, overhead transmission lines (OHTL) and underground cable projects in line with approved scope, timelines and budget.

•Manage end-to-end delivery of substation civil infrastructure (equipment foundations, control buildings, cable trenches, drainage systems, access roads) and transmission line tower foundations in compliance with geotechnical reports and design specifications.
•Provide leadership to project teams, site engineers and subcontractors by setting clear objectives, monitoring performance and optimizing resource utilization.
•Oversee project financials, planning and scheduling: budget control, cost forecasting, material optimization and progress tracking to achieve milestones and a smooth project handover.
•Review and approve civil and structural designs, and ensure adherence to NCC standards, local authority regulations, client specifications and HSE policies across all phases.
•Evaluate subcontractor quotations, review quantity take-offs, BOQs and payment applications, and manage variations and claims related to civil works.
•Coordinate with clients, consultants and internal teams, review pre-tender site surveys, and report regularly to top management on project status, risks and mitigation plans.
